controls.name: Response time
controls.notes: Faster suits content with a lot of motion. Listed as F7(00 01 02 03) and read back at each of those values (#33); the same values and names as the other LG models in the library.

controls.name: 1ms Motion Blur Reduction
controls.notes: Read back at 0x01 and 0x02 as the menu changed (#33). The capabilities string lists FA(00 01); what 0x00 does is not known.

controls.name: Gamma
controls.notes: Read back at 2, 3, 4 and 16 as the menu's gamma changed (#33); the share named the last 0x16, but 16 is 0x10. Read-only: the LG UltraWide GSM-5BF7 reads the same four values here and ignores writes, its gamma answers on 0x72 instead (#31).
